qa.original_review_text: - **Q1 Uniform missing/non-member responses incl. revoked cursors — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: 404 vs 422 for a revoked member's still-valid cursor. Exact source: RC-1 (check order), RC-3, RC-6; approved permission-matrix sensitive-denial and revocation-recheck rules. Answer: byte-identical 404 for non-member, nonexistent, foreign and kind-mismatched ids and for a revoked caller presenting a valid cursor (membership precedes cursor validation); no 403 on reads. Smallest correction: none; optionally add the cursor-after-revocation example line. Owner: none (documented) / Codex intake.

- **Q2 Partial section failure within the single overview boundary — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: what distinguishes section failure reasons. Source: READ-02; FR-009 approved error behavior; AC-156 approved distinguishability. Answer: root 200 with per-section availability; UNAVAILABLE+null; null counts never 0; condition INCOMPLETE; STALE client-only; 503 only for snapshot-open failure or zero available sections. Correction: F-02 (code vocabulary). Owner: Claude.

- **Q3 Shared overview revision; newer pages labeled, not merged — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: none material. Source: READ-02, addendum snapshot semantics, NAV rules. Answer: every continuation/detail response is its own boundary with its own asOf/sourceRevision, labeled "changed since overview" when newer, never merged; point lookups never patch the overview. Correction: none.

- **Q4 Complete cursor reachability and actor/Matter binding — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-01 open).** Source: RC-6/RC-7 + the section/continuation order-equality invariant. Answer: yes for the seven paginated sections via their named routes; opaque cursors bound to actor/matter/collection/filter/sort; mismatch → 422 without detail; revoked → 404. Correction: F-01 for the DR-06 two-sided envelope. Owner: Claude.

- **Q5 Exact assessment/submission versions after promotion — ANSWERED_FROM_APPROVED_SOURCE.** Source: approved RULE-011 and AC-128; contract reference rules make it wire-level. Answer: exact `assessedDocumentVersionRef`, `submittedVersionRefs`, `criterionRevisionRef`, `submissionId` are retained; the current pointer is never substituted (NAV-07); fixed-version criteria unaffected. Correction: none.

- **Q6 AtlasT0 empty Next Actions and RQ-04 root-cause visibility — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-03/F-11 open).** Source: approved RULE-021, READ-02 `excluded[]`, dependency-engine §5/§7, blockers rootCause rule. Answer: `items: []` explained by `excluded[]`; no Requirements, no invented work; RQ-04 appears as root-cause blocker card (WAITING+READY, failing DEP-01); no metric invented. Corrections: F-03 (reason precedence), F-11 (critical designation). Owners: Claude / Codex.

- **Q7 No domain-history/verification mutation or payload logging on reads — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE.** Ambiguity: whether denial-audit is a "mutation". Source: RC-9, ADR-002 §1.6 (reads never write), approved permission-matrix audit rule, FR-008. Answer: reads create no domain event, verification or history; the only write is the approved restricted security audit on denial; no tokens/payloads in logs; security audit never appears in DR-15 events. Correction: none.

- **Q8 Uniform not-found for kind-mismatched resource IDs — RESOLVED_IN_REVIEWED_CANDIDATE (F-05 adjacent).** Source: RC-3, addendum authorization blocks, CT-05. Answer: an Action id on `/requirements/{id}`, a claimId on `/evidence/{id}`, an edgeRef on `/nodes/{id}` all return the same byte-identical 404. Correction: F-05 pins the separate malformed-id case. Owner: Claude.
